record.paper_title: Some of my favorite open problems
record.original_question: Let Omega be a smooth bounded domain in R^N, N >= 2, let f be smooth on the closure of Omega, and minimize Phi(u)=integral_Omega |grad u| + (1/2) integral_Omega |u-f|^2 over BV(Omega) intersect L^2(Omega). The minimizer U is known to satisfy grad U in L^infinity(Omega), though grad U need not be continuous. Does grad U belong to BV(Omega)?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 8.1 ([20, Open Problem 1]). Does grad U belong to BV(Omega)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^N$ with $N \geq 2$ be a smooth bounded domain, and let $f \in C^\infty(\overline{\Omega})$. Consider the functional
$$\Phi(u) = \int_\Omega |
abla u| +  rac{1}{2}\int_\Omega |u-f|^2,$$
defined for $u \in BV(\Omega) \cap L^2(\Omega)$, where $\int_\Omega |
abla u|$ denotes the total variation of $u$. It is known that $\Phi$ admits a unique minimizer $U \in BV(\Omega) \cap L^2(\Omega)$, and that $
abla U \in L^\infty(\Omega)$ (although $
abla U$ need not be continuous in general). Determine whether $
abla U \in BV(\Omega)$, i.e., whether each component of the (a.e. defined) gradient of $U$ is a function of bounded variation on $\Omega$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is recorded as an open problem in Brezis's work on minimization problems associated with BV norms. The 1D analogue has been resolved (when $f' \in BV(0,1)$, the minimizer satisfies $U' \in BV$, via a duality reduction to a variational inequality), but the duality trick does not extend to $N \geq 2$. No publication establishing or disproving $\nabla U \in BV(\Omega)$ in higher dimensions has been located.

status_evidence.title: Remarks on some minimization problems associated with BV norms
status_evidence.snippet: Brezis formulates the question of whether the minimizer U satisfies grad U in BV(Omega) for N>=2 as an open problem; the 1D version is resolved by a duality argument that does not extend to higher dimensions.
status_evidence.claim: Problem stated as open in dimension N>=2; 1D case settled.

status_evidence.title: Some of my favorite open problems — Haim Brezis
status_evidence.snippet: Listed among favorite open problems concerning BV regularity of total-variation minimizers.
